title: The Smelliest Job in Medieval England #Shorts
description:
This job smelled so bad, towns pushed it outside the walls. Turning animal skins into leather was one of the smelliest jobs in history. Skins were scraped, soaked for months in pits, and softened with a paste made of dung.
